comment: codex credits: a headless `codex exec` or `codex review` started while the weekly Codex limit is below the review role's threshold in models.toml is billed to credits. On 2026-11-13 four Sol reviews ran at 100% used. The stand-in codex reports 100% used for every case here; deny cases must name the left share, the threshold, the fallback `role review` picks and the owner override. Allow cases only mention codex, ask it for help or its version, or carry the owner's override.

deny.name: the incident: a Sol review through codex exec
deny.command: codex exec -c model="gpt-6.1-sol" -c model_reasoning_effort="medium" --ephemeral -o review.md - < prompt.md

deny.name: behind env and nohup
deny.command: env FOO=1 nohup codex exec 'review' > out.log 2>&1 &

deny.name: the override on another command only
leased through slotfather
deny.command: slotfather run -n 1 --label 'r5 sol review' -- codex exec 'review'

deny.name: owned by junkfather
deny.command: junkfather own --ttl 20m --label r5 -- codex review --base main

deny.name: an unknown global option with a value

allow.name: text that names it
allow.command: grep -rn 'codex exec' docs && echo codex review

allow.name: a commit message
allow.command: git commit -qm 'refuse codex exec on credits'

allow.name: the override before a lease
allow.command: MASTACK_ALLOW_CREDITS=1 slotfather run -n 1 --label 'r5 sol review' -- codex exec 'review'

allow.name: an interactive session with a prompt
a leased test that names codex
allow.command: slotfather run -n 1 --label 'r5 codex tests' -- python3 tests/codex_test.py
